source_coverage.completed_sweep: MedalBook Kingdom of Sardinia & Kingdom of Italy: 5/5 listing pages; 343/343 distinct linked object pages cached/opened. The site reported 344 results; one result was not a distinct opened object page.
source_coverage.this_package_reconciliation: 3 of 163 provisional family keys selected; all 7 MedalBook candidate rows inside those keys reviewed and merged into 3 award families. 160 keys / 336 candidate rows remain pending; no claim of full-family normalization.
source_coverage.image_policy: MedalBook commercial photographs were discovery leads only and were not downloaded. All four selected local images are from Commons pages with declared reusable licenses; two selected cross views are paired as the same physical object.
